chunks: Al-Fuḍayl ibn Yasār asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
About a man who prayed with an Imam whom he was following, then raised his head from sajdah before the Imam raised his head from sajdah. He said: “Then let him perform sajdah.”

key_terms.إِمَامٍ: the prayer leader being followed in congregational salat
key_terms.السُّجُودِ: the act of prostration in salat
key_terms.رَأْسَهُ: his head, referring to lifting it from prostration
key_terms.يَأْتَمُّ: follows in prayer behind the Imam

ai.seo_question: What should a follower do if he raises his head from sajdah before the Imam in congregational salat?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for one praying in congregation who raises his head from sajdah before the Imam. The Imam عليه السلام instructs him to return to sajdah, emphasizing proper following of the Imam in congregational salat.
